content.body:
During the early days when the German High Command was creating the concept of the Panzer Division it was soon realized that the tanks would quickly outdistance their covering infantry, and that trucks were not capable of carrying the infantry forward in any sort of rough combat environment. In 1935, they decided to armor the reliable SdKfz.11 half track to give the infantry good mobility even off road. Version C was developed after the Polish campaign, including a number of features improving the interior layout and simplifying construction. The SdKfz.251 quickly became the hallmark of the German Panzergrenadiers and one of the most successful early armored personnel carriers. The 251 was adapted for anything: every situation in which mobility was needed but a truck would be too vulnerable, the 251 was the likely choice for modification. Eventually nearly 30 official variants were produced with everything from flamethrowers to Infra-Red searchlights meant to illuminate the battlefield for the novel IR targeting system developed late in the war.
Control Variations: Crew 1 H key also opens side window armor panel, making driver vulnerable to side shots to the head. Key O opens the rear door. Crew 2 is the machine gunner, and begins deployed in firing position. Using the numpad . Or Ins key will cause him to look through the MG sights, which are not adjustable for range. The O key at crew 2 (gunner) will cause him to sit on the floor of the vehicle under cover, from where he may not fire the MG but is better protected when under enemy fire.
The SdKfz.251 is the only armored personnel carrier in the game so far. Open-topped, it is a nice target for grenades and snipers, but it still is exceptionally good at delivering infantry into bullet riddled combat operations. The LMG above the drivers position is handy, but is also very vulnerabe to return fire from enemy infantry.
When spawned, usually the first thing you should do is to jump to crew position 2 and hit the O to pull him down into the vehicle, although some drivers swear by leaving him up as a sort of "sniper detector" since the enamy apparently cannot resist shooting him when he is exposed. You actually have quite good armor for a light vehicle, due to the steep slope on most of the surfaces. Of course nothing is going to help you if someone lobs a grenade into your rear bed, so you need to spend very little time dawdling in the combat area. If your infantry need support, drive up, drop them off, then pull back (either reverse or turn around and dash back) ... your MG fire has decent range and you are better capable of covering a wider area the further back you are.
content.brief: TYPE: Armored Personnel Carrier ARMAMENT: 1 x MG34 LMG WEIGHT: 7850 kg SPEED (road): 58 km/h
